tb21_profile.skill: Run pdflatex, read its log for overfull-hbox diagnostics, and search a restricted synonym-substitution space until every warning is gone
tb21_profile.domain: LaTeX/TeX typesetting toolchain (pdflatex, .tex/.log), plain-text source editing
tb21_profile.task_form: optimise/satisfy-a-constraint under a hard edit restriction, with a compiler as the only oracle; iterate until diagnostics are empty

verifier_notes: No grade disputed. Noted that the whole LaTeX-domain slice of Recursive-Task-Synthesis is 'absent' (corpus-wide), and TerminalWorld's LaTeX/PDF slice is almost entirely FREE (tw_495570, tw_430004, tw_481830, tw_220417, tw_129867, tw_362046) - those are listed in per_source but kept out of final_top10. tw_96480 and tw_287590 are the only graded LaTeX tasks TerminalWorld has.
searches: tools.py search all 'without any warnings|no warnings|zero warnings|warning-free|-Werror|eliminate (all )?warnings'
tools.py search all 'text justification|word wrap|line[- ]break|justif(y|ied) (the )?text|greedy wrapping|fill column'
tools.py search tmax 'latex|\.tex\b|typeset|-Werror|zero warnings|no warnings|compiler warning'
tools.py search tmax 'only .{0,20}(replace|substitut|edit)|may not modify|must not modify|without modifying|search over (all )?(possible|combinations)|brute.force.*(combinations|search)'

TMax-15K.reason: Must not modify the validator binary; edit only the input lines until the oracle stops crashing - same restricted-edit feedback loop.
Constraint satisfaction over a finite candidate space (z3 or brute force) - the synonym search in overfull-hbox is the same shape.
Fix C sources until make with -Wall -Werror -O3 emits nothing; iterate on compiler diagnostics rather than on a spec.
-Werror halts the build on a returned stack pointer; must read the diagnostic and edit source until the toolchain is silent.
Makefile configured with -Werror fails; repeated build-read-error-edit cycles, same loop as pdflatex-log-driven editing.
-Werror catches implicit declarations; fix includes until the build target passes. Warning-elimination loop, different toolchain.
Fix CMakeLists so cmake && make succeeds WITHOUT modifying the source - an edit-restriction constraint like the synonyms-only rule.
Repair C until gcc -O2 -Wall -Werror compiles it, then run and check output; compiler-in-the-loop repair.
Circular struct dependency blocks compilation; diagnose from compiler output and restructure until it builds.
Author a Makefile that compiles under -Wall -Werror; build-toolchain work but no search and no diagnostic-driven iteration.

Recursive-Task-Synthesis.reason: pdflatex itself is broken and must be diagnosed from its own error output before the document will compile - same tool, same log-reading.
PDF must contain no '??' placeholders: forces re-running pdflatex and reading its cross-reference diagnostics until clean, exactly the hbox loop.
LaTeX compilation must succeed with no missing-package or font errors; read pdflatex errors, install, recompile, repeat.
Compile showcase.tex with a custom document class and make sure cross-references resolve - multi-pass pdflatex discipline.
Clean rebuild with all compiler warnings enabled and confirm zero remain - the warning-elimination goal in a C toolchain.
Splint must report no warnings, and the exact flags must be discovered from the source; drive a checker to silence.
Produce .tex with required layout markers, compile with pdflatex, then pass validate.sh - LaTeX source editing judged by a checker.
Requires parsing the generated .tex for every referenced package; LaTeX source comprehension but no compile-feedback loop.
Produce a standalone .tex from history and compile it with pdflatex; LaTeX toolchain use, mostly git plumbing otherwise.
pdflatex compile is only a sanity check inside a git/pandoc chore; shares the tool, not the failure mode.

TerminalWorld-Seeds-Clean.reason: Fill a LaTeX template from data, emit .tex, compile to PDF; real pdflatex work and one of only two graded LaTeX tasks here.
Compile showcase.tex with the Metanorma class to a valid 5-page PDF; class-file placement errors must be read out of the pdflatex log.
Run Splint on two C files and compare diagnostics; static-analyser-output reading, but FREE-graded so excluded from final_top10.
HTML to LaTeX intermediate to PDF; LaTeX domain only, FREE verifier - a PDF that merely exists passes.
Produce a standalone .tex and commit it; touches LaTeX source but never compiles it. FREE verifier.
AsciiDoc book to PDF - a document-build toolchain that will fail loudly and need iteration, but FREE-graded.
Build Git from source with OpenSSL and cURL: configure-build-read-error loop, unrelated domain, but strongly verified.
Webpage to PDF with any tool; only the PDF-production domain overlaps, and the verifier is FREE.
Build a project from source until compilation completes; generic build-until-it-works, FREE verifier.
Compile and run an MPI program; toolchain invocation only, no diagnostic-driven search.

SWE-Smith-Seeds-Clean.reason: Table does not respect its max width, causing unexpected line breaks and misalignment - the same width-overflow reasoning as an overfull hbox.
layout_width / layout_width_chars mutual-exclusion bug in PDF text layout; reasoning about measured widths on a page.
Word-cloud placement fits words into a bounded canvas by search over sizes and positions; box-packing intuition transfers weakly.
Document object model for a typeset format (paragraphs, runs, styles); shares the typesetting subject, not the compile loop.
PDF text extraction depends on glyph boxes and line grouping - adjacent to how TeX measures boxes, but a pure library bug fix.
Presentation document model and layout placeholders; same 'lay content into fixed boxes' territory, no compiler feedback.
Markup renderer bug: parse markup, emit formatted output. Markup processing only, no typographic constraint.
Programmatic document generation with nested markup; shares the 'emit a document that must be well formed' shape.
Static-site document build pipeline; a build-and-render chain, but the failure is a Python regression, not a renderer diagnostic.
2D module placement in a fixed grid; only the vaguest layout analogy, unrelated stack.

SWE-Rebench-Tasks-Clean.reason: Hyphenation fails when a nbsp appears in the word: a line-breaking bug in a paginating layout engine, the exact mechanism behind overfull hboxes.
Duplicate text when RTL runs are laid out into PDF; requires reasoning about how a renderer breaks and places text runs.
Font unicode-range handling in a HTML-to-PDF renderer; font metrics decide box widths, so the domain is genuinely shared.
Crash inside Sphinx's LaTeX builder while assembling the doctree; the only Rebench task in the actual LaTeX output path.
Font source tooling; glyph metrics are what make a line overfull, but the task is a data round-trip bug.
Parser loses content across line breaks in raw blocks; markup line-handling, no layout measurement.
Template rendering and whitespace handling; document generation, but nothing measures or constrains output width.
Transpile-then-compile pipeline where the backend compiler's errors surface to the user; mild compiler-in-the-loop overlap.
Line-level analysis of source text; shares only the 'reason about lines of a text file' surface.
Dependency-tree text rendering; listed to fill the quota, nothing about typography or constrained search transfers.

Terminal-Lego-15k.reason: Real LaTeX authoring problem: get a literal backslash through \write, verified by actually running pdflatex and checking the emitted file.
Install a TeX distribution and drive nbconvert's pdflatex backend until conversion succeeds; failures surface only as pdflatex errors.
Same conversion via the xelatex backend; TeX-distribution package hunting driven by the engine's own error messages.
Whole-project LaTeX workflow including latexdiff and ignoring .aux/.log build artefacts; teaches the TeX build model, not the hbox fix.
Make tlmgr fonts visible to xelatex/lualatex via fontconfig - genuine TeX-distribution debugging, but FREE-graded so barred from final_top10.
Write and render LaTeX math in Jupyter; LaTeX syntax practice with a MathJax renderer instead of a TeX engine.
Control SymPy's LaTeX rendering of multi-expression cells; LaTeX output plumbing, no compilation constraint.
Get Angstrom and lambda to render through matplotlib's LaTeX text path; font/encoding troubleshooting in a mathtext renderer.
Embed a LaTeX formula in a matplotlib legend; escaping and mathtext syntax only.
Read a compiler's fatal error and fix the Makefile include path until make succeeds; diagnostic-driven repair, wrong toolchain.

CalibForge.reason: System CFLAGS carry -Werror and must not be overridden: the only legal move is editing the source until every warning disappears. Structurally identical constraint.
K&R C must build with zero warnings under the provided Makefile, which you may not relax; iterate on gcc diagnostics until silent.
make must build library and test program with no warnings or errors; repeated build-read-fix cycles against fixed flags.
Eliminate strict-aliasing warnings under -Wall -Wextra and UBSan findings too; two independent diagnostic streams must both go quiet.
Get a legacy tool compiling cleanly under -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 and produce correct output; warning elimination plus a pinned result.
Stricter gcc with -Werror in the Makefile rejects code that used to build; read each diagnostic and repair rather than loosen flags.
Must compile under -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 while keeping output format fixed - two constraints held simultaneously, like main.tex being off-limits.
Install a compiler, then make csv2json build cleanly under -Wall -Werror -Wextra and behave correctly; toolchain setup plus warning cleanup.
Produce correct statistics with no warnings and fix header dependency tracking; build-system reasoning under a no-warnings requirement.
2005-era sources will not compile on modern GCC; repeatedly read compiler complaints and adjust until the shared library links.

final_top10.reason: The only graded task in the pool that writes LaTeX and is verified by actually running pdflatex and inspecting what it produced.
No '??' placeholders allowed in the PDF: forces multi-pass pdflatex and log reading until a typographic defect is gone. Verifier absent.
-Werror is fixed and unoverridable, so the only legal move is editing content until the tool stops complaining - the same constrained loop, strongly verified.
A line-breaking and hyphenation bug in a paginating layout engine: the exact mechanism that produces an overfull hbox.
pdflatex itself is broken and must be diagnosed from its output before anything compiles; same tool, same log-reading skill.
Generate a .tex from a template and compile it to PDF with a graded verifier - TerminalWorld's only genuinely checked LaTeX task.
Compilation must succeed with no missing-package or font errors; read pdflatex errors, install, recompile until the log is clean.
Install a TeX distribution and drive the pdflatex backend until conversion succeeds; failures appear only as pdflatex diagnostics.
Zero warnings required under a Makefile you may not relax; pure diagnostic-elimination loop with a well-pinned verifier.
Clean rebuild with all warnings enabled and confirm zero remain - the warning-count-to-zero objective, in C rather than TeX.

notes: The pool has essentially no task about constrained word substitution or text justification; searches for 'synonym', 'thesaurus', 'text justification' and 'word wrap' returned nothing usable. So transfer here splits into two families: (a) LaTeX/pdflatex domain, which only Recursive-Task-Synthesis (all 'absent'), Terminal-Lego and two TerminalWorld tasks supply, and (b) 'edit the content until a fixed, unmodifiable tool emits zero diagnostics', which CalibForge supplies in quantity and with the best verifiers. CalibForge contains no LaTeX at all; TMax contains no LaTeX at all. TerminalWorld could not field 10 defensible candidates - ranks 3-10 are filler and six of them are FREE. SWE-Smith ranks 4-10 and SWE-Rebench ranks 5-10 are also quota filler, scored 1-2 accordingly. RTS's LaTeX slice is large but is the same online-CV-to-PDF template repeated dozens of times; I picked the variants that actually require reacting to compiler output rather than the pure git/pandoc chores.
